rv.q: But timing is on the Almeida’s side, for the central character in this piece, efficiently directed by James Macdonald, is a White House press secretary, and we all know what has just happened to the latest real-life occupant of that job .

Which made its portrait of a press secretary in a blonde wig announcing the achievements of the Emperor to a waiting world all the more telling. At just over 15 minutes, you’d call it a jeu d’esprit , or a sketch, except that fails to describe its utterly chilling quality.
Proof that even at 88, one of the finest playwrights of the last few decades still has plenty to say.
